items.title: Ray Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, AZ, April 16, 2000
items.q: I played with Dexter but I didn't record.

ctx.x: Yeah. That you could have maybe enjoyed doing an album with?

There are a couple of people I didn’t record with but I played with them. I never recorded with Miles and I never recorded with Dexter Gordon. I never recorded with Eroll Garner. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

I grew up with him. But I mean I played with him many times. I played with Miles, he played in Dizzy’s big band. I played with Dexter but I didn’t record. There’s maybe a half a dozen people that I never recorded with, but just about everybody I’ve played with somewhere.
